HEIC photo conversion component

This application optionally uses heic-to 1.5.2, distributed under the
GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 or later. The component is
loaded as a separate module only when native browser decoding is unavailable.
It is provided WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY, including MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS
FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the accompanying GPL-3.0.txt, LGPL-3.0.txt,
and UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt.

The application does not modify the decoder. Its CSP build uses libheif
1.22.2 and libde265 1.0.16. Corresponding upstream source and build instructions:

heic-to (including the CSP build recipe):
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/f37af866f9aa6212ddc84b67a279c9f2386aba4f

libheif:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.22.2

libde265:
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16

The original heic-to README is included as UPSTREAM-README.md.
The LGPL component may be replaced or modified independently of the main
application; reverse engineering for debugging such modifications is permitted.
